title: Oven-Roasted Thai Mung Bean Sprouts Skewers
description: Savory and creamy oven-roasted mung bean sprout skewers that capture the essence of Thai street food with a lazy Sunday twist.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Toss mung bean sprouts, bell pepper, carrot, and zucchini with olive oil, lime juice, garlic powder, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper in a bowl until evenly coated.
Thread the seasoned vegetables onto skewers, packing them tightly to help them stay together during grilling.
Brush the skewers with sunflower seed butter, creating a creamy coating that glazes while roasting.
Place the skewers on the preheated grill and cook for 10 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for 2 minutes so the flavors meld.
Serve the hot skewers on a platter, optionally drizzling with extra lime juice or a splash of coconut milk for extra creaminess.
Garnish with fresh herbs if desired and enjoy the savory, creamy Thai-inspired dish.
